metadata.method: Independent synthetic directed-chain stress experiment using the production UAFLoc entropy, ranking, initialization, and Bayesian update functions. Each size and seed uses the same sampled fault location across all methods. Partial scenarios omit direct probes on every fifth unknown link. All observations are deterministic given a selected probe and hidden synthetic fault. Confidence stopping threshold is 0.85. Algorithm runtime excludes network latency and storage.

metricDefinitions.diagnosedAccuracy: Correct top posterior hypothesis among runs reaching 0.85 confidence; null when no run completed.
metricDefinitions.top1Accuracy: Truth is the highest posterior hypothesis across every run, including unresolved runs.
metricDefinitions.top3Accuracy: Truth is among the three highest posterior hypotheses across every run.
metricDefinitions.completionRate: Fraction reaching at least 0.85 posterior confidence within the 20-probe budget.
metricDefinitions.brierScore: Mean multiclass Brier score over the full hypothesis distribution; lower is better.
metricDefinitions.meanExecutionMs: Measured JavaScript algorithm time in-process; not network latency.
